text:
Škoda Kodiaq > Overview

The second-generation Kodiaq is Škoda's full-size SUV. Trims: Lounge, Sportline and Selection L&K. Lounge is a 5-seater; Sportline and Selection L&K are 7-seaters.

Škoda Kodiaq > Engine and gearbox

Every Kodiaq uses a 2.0 TSI turbo-petrol engine with 150 kW (204 PS) and 320 Nm, a 7-speed DSG automatic and 4x4.

Škoda Kodiaq > Safety

The Kodiaq has up to 9 airbags (the count depends on the variant), ESC, ABS, a multi-collision brake, hill descent control and driver attention alert. Sportline and Selection L&K add ADAS features (Front Assist, Side Assist and Exit Warning), a 360-degree camera and Intelligent Park Assist.

Škoda Kodiaq > Comfort and infotainment

The Kodiaq has a 32.77 cm (12.9-inch) touchscreen and a 26.03 cm (10.25-inch) Virtual Cockpit. Selection L&K adds ventilated and massaging front seats. Matrix LED headlights are fitted.

Škoda Kushaq > Overview

The Kushaq is Škoda's mid-size SUV, updated with a 2026 facelift. It has a 5-star Global NCAP safety rating. Trims: Classic+, Signature, Sportline, Prestige and Monte Carlo.

Škoda Kushaq > Engines and gearboxes

The 1.0 TSI turbo-petrol (85 kW, 115 PS, 178 Nm) comes with a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed torque-converter automatic. The 1.5 TSI turbo-petrol (110 kW, 150 PS, 250 Nm) comes with a 7-speed DSG automatic and has disc brakes on all four wheels.

Škoda Kushaq > Safety

Škoda lists 25 active and passive safety features as standard across the range, and up to 40 on the top variants. Every Kushaq has 6 airbags, ESC, ABS with EBD, traction control, rear parking sensors and ISOFIX mounts. Hill-hold assist is standard on the automatic Classic+ and on every Signature and above.

Signature adds a tyre pressure monitoring system, a rear parking camera, front and rear parking sensors and LED fog lamps with a cornering function. Prestige adds an anti-theft alarm.

Škoda Kushaq > Comfort and convenience

Classic+ already has automatic climate control with an air purifier and rear vents, an electric sunroof and rain-sensing wipers. Signature adds keyless entry, cruise control, a cooled glove box and 60:40 split rear seats. Prestige adds a panoramic sunroof, powered and ventilated front seats, a rear seat massage function and beige leatherette upholstery. Monte Carlo has a black cabin with red trim and red stitching.

Škoda Kushaq > Infotainment

Classic+ has a 7-inch touchscreen with wired Android Auto and Apple CarPlay and 6 speakers. Signature adds a 10.1-inch touchscreen with wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, an 8-inch digital driver's display and a 15W wireless phone charger. Prestige adds a Škoda sound system with subwoofer and amplifier.

Škoda Kushaq > Exterior

Every Kushaq has automatic LED headlamps, LED tail lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. Signature gets 17-inch silver alloys and an illuminated light band on the grille. Sportline has 17-inch black alloys and Sportline badging. Monte Carlo has 17-inch dual-tone alloys, red grille stripes and Monte Carlo badges.

Škoda Kylaq > Overview

The Kylaq is Škoda's compact SUV for India, under 4 metres long. It has a 5-star Bharat NCAP safety rating. It is sold in seven trims: Classic, Classic+, Signature, Signature+, Sportline, Prestige and Prestige+.

Škoda Kylaq > Engine and gearbox

Every Kylaq uses the 1.0 TSI turbo-petrol engine with 85 kW (115 PS) and 178 Nm. It comes with a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed torque-converter automatic. The automatic is available from the Classic+ trim upwards; the base Classic is manual only.

Škoda Kylaq > Safety

Standard on every trim: 6 airbags, ABS with EBD, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), traction control, brake disc wiping, roll-over protection, rear parking sensors and ISOFIX child-seat mounts.

Signature adds a tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS). Signature+ adds hill-hold assist and a rear parking camera. Sportline adds LED fog lamps with a cornering function. Prestige adds an anti-theft alarm.

Škoda Kylaq > Comfort and convenience

Classic+ adds a single-pane electric sunroof, cruise control, an auto-dimming inside mirror, steering-mounted controls and one-touch driver window. Signature adds rear AC vents, a cooled glove box, rain-sensing wipers, a rear wiper and washer, and paddle shifters on the automatic. Signature+ adds keyless entry and go, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and 60:40 split-folding rear seats. Prestige adds ventilated front seats and leatherette upholstery. Prestige+ adds 6-way powered front seats.

Škoda Kylaq > Infotainment

Signature has a 7-inch touchscreen with wired Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. Signature+ upgrades to a 10-inch touchscreen with wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, an 8-inch digital instrument cluster and connected-car features. Sportline and Prestige add a wireless phone charger.

Škoda Kylaq > Exterior

Classic has 16-inch steel wheels. Signature gets 16-inch silver alloy wheels. Sportline has 17-inch black alloys, a rear spoiler and LED projector headlamps. Prestige has 17-inch dual-tone alloys and LED projector headlamps.

Škoda Octavia RS > Overview

The Octavia RS is Škoda's performance sedan, imported in limited numbers. It comes in one fully loaded version. Colours: Mamba Green, Magic Black and Velvet Red.

Škoda Octavia RS > Engine and performance

A 2.0 TSI turbo-petrol engine with 195 kW (265 PS) and 370 Nm drives the front wheels through a 7-speed DSG automatic. It reaches 0-100 km/h in 6.4 seconds, and top speed is electronically limited to 250 km/h.
section: Škoda Octavia RS > Engine and performance

text:
Škoda Octavia RS > Safety and driver assistance

The Octavia RS has 10 airbags, adaptive cruise control, Front Assist, Lane Assist, blind spot detection, ESC, a 360-degree Area View camera and Intelligent Park Assist.
section: Škoda Octavia RS > Safety and driver assistance

text:
Škoda Octavia RS > Comfort and infotainment

Heated, power-adjustable front sports seats with memory and massage, a head-up display, a Virtual Cockpit, three-zone Climatronic air conditioning and ambient lighting. A 32.77 cm touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a Canton 675W sound system, wireless charging and USB-C ports.
section: Škoda Octavia RS > Comfort and infotainment

text:
Škoda Octavia RS > Exterior

Full LED Matrix headlights with Adaptive Front Lighting, LED rear lights with animated indicators, RS bumpers, a sports exhaust with two visible tailpipes and gloss black accents.

Škoda Slavia > Overview

The Slavia is Škoda's mid-size sedan, updated for 2026. It has a 5-star Global NCAP safety rating. Trims: Classic, Classic+, Signature, Sportline, Prestige and Monte Carlo. The 1.5 TSI engine is offered only on Prestige and Monte Carlo.

Škoda Slavia > Engines and gearboxes

The 1.0 TSI turbo-petrol (85 kW, 115 PS, 178 Nm) comes with a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed torque-converter automatic. The 1.5 TSI turbo-petrol (110 kW, 150 PS, 250 Nm) comes with a 7-speed DSG automatic and Active Cylinder Technology.

Škoda Slavia > Safety

Standard on every Slavia: 6 airbags, stability control, traction control, a tyre pressure monitor, ISOFIX mounts and rear parking sensors. Classic+ automatic adds hill-hold control. Signature adds a rear-view camera and front and rear parking sensors. Sportline adds a 360-degree camera.

Škoda Slavia > Comfort and convenience

Classic has automatic climate control, a height-adjustable driver's seat, power windows and auto start/stop. Classic+ adds a single-pane sunroof, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, an auto-dimming mirror and paddle shifters on the automatic. Signature adds ambient lighting, keyless entry, push-button start, 60:40 split folding rear seats, a cooled glove box and rear AC vents. Prestige adds powered and ventilated front seats, a rear seat massage function and leatherette upholstery.

Škoda Slavia > Infotainment

Classic has a 7-inch touchscreen with wired smartphone connectivity and 4 speakers. Signature adds a 10.1-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a Google AI assistant, an 8-speaker sound system and a wireless phone charger. Prestige adds a 10.25-inch digital driver's display.

Škoda Slavia > Exterior

Classic has halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Classic+ adds 16-inch alloy wheels, full-LED headlamps, LED fog lamps and sequential rear indicators. Sportline has 16-inch black alloys and a boot lip spoiler. Monte Carlo adds red grille accents and red brake calipers.

Škoda India general FAQ > Which Škoda models are on sale in India?

Kylaq (compact SUV), Kushaq (mid-size SUV), Slavia (mid-size sedan), Kodiaq (full-size SUV with 5 or 7 seats) and Octavia RS (performance sedan). All of them are petrol cars. The Superb is still shown on the Škoda India website but is reported as discontinued, so check with a dealer.
section: Škoda India general FAQ > Which Škoda models are on sale in India?

text:
Škoda India general FAQ > Does Škoda sell an electric car in India?

Not yet. The Enyaq electric SUV is expected in India, but Škoda has not announced its launch date, price or India specifications. Any figures you see are media estimates.
section: Škoda India general FAQ > Does Škoda sell an electric car in India?

Škoda India general FAQ > Where can I find a Škoda dealer?

Use the official dealer locator at dealers.skoda-auto.co.in, or tell this assistant your city, area or pincode to get the nearest showrooms and service centres.
section: Škoda India general FAQ > Where can I find a Škoda dealer?

text:
Škoda India general FAQ > Are prices the same everywhere?

Ex-showroom prices can vary slightly between states, and the on-road price depends on your state's road tax, registration, insurance and other charges. Ask this assistant for an estimated on-road price for your city, and confirm the final price with the dealer.
section: Škoda India general FAQ > Are prices the same everywhere?

text:
Škoda service FAQ > How often should my car be serviced?

New Škoda cars get two free inspections, at 1,000 km or 1 month and at 7,500 km or 6 months. After that, periodic maintenance is due every 15,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first.
section: Škoda service FAQ > How often should my car be serviced?

text:
Škoda service FAQ > What is done at a periodic service?

Every periodic service replaces the engine oil, oil filter, drain plug washer and cabin filter, and includes sunroof lubrication on cars with a sunroof. Every 30,000 km the air filter and brake fluid are also replaced. At 60,000 km the spark plugs and V-belt are replaced. Automatic (torque-converter) cars also get an automatic transmission fluid (ATF) change at 60,000 km, which makes that service noticeably more expensive.
section: Škoda service FAQ > What is done at a periodic service?

text:
Škoda service FAQ > How do I book a service?

Book online at skoda-auto.co.in/service-and-parts/book-service-appointment, or call your nearest Škoda service centre. You can find service centres, their phone numbers and opening hours with the dealer locator at dealers.skoda-auto.co.in, or ask this assistant for the nearest one.
section: Škoda service FAQ > How do I book a service?

text:
Škoda service FAQ > What services do service centres offer?

Authorised Škoda service centres handle periodic maintenance, repairs and genuine accessories. Some outlets are combined showroom and service centres.
section: Škoda service FAQ > What services do service centres offer?

text:
Škoda service FAQ > What should I do if my car breaks down?

Call Škoda Assist, the 24x7 Pan-India roadside assistance included for 4 years with new cars. Details are at skoda-auto.co.in/service-and-parts/roadside-assistance.
section: Škoda service FAQ > What should I do if my car breaks down?

Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Standard warranty

Škoda Super Care lists a 4-year / 100,000 km standard warranty. The Kushaq, Slavia and Kodiaq model pages state the same. Check the warranty booklet or your dealer for the exact terms for your car.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Standard warranty

text:
Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Extended warranty

Extended warranty (EW) can extend cover up to the 6th year of ownership. Terms and prices are on skoda-auto.co.in/skoda-super-care/skoda-extended-warranty. Škoda also offers an Anytime Warranty, described at skoda-auto.co.in/skoda-super-care/anytime-warranty. Ask your dealer for the exact cover and cost for your car.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Extended warranty

text:
Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Parts warranty

Škoda Super Care lists a parts warranty of 2 years or unlimited kilometres.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Parts warranty

text:
Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Labour-free services

Škoda Super Care includes 4 labour-free services in the first two years. You still pay for parts and consumables such as engine oil and filters.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Labour-free services

text:
Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Roadside assistance

New cars include 4 years of 24x7 Pan-India roadside assistance (Škoda Assist). Details: skoda-auto.co.in/service-and-parts/roadside-assistance.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Roadside assistance

text:
Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Maintenance plans

Škoda offers Maintenance Plans. The Super Care page does not list their contents or prices, so ask your dealer which plans are available for your model.
section: Škoda Super Care: warranty and ownership package > Maintenance plans
